Is Kenai more modern or traditional? Kenai leans modern but remains versatile enough to work in both contemporary and traditional designs. Travis Choate Project Coordinator What colors are in Kenai stone panels? Kenai features a blend of cool gray tones with subtle variation, creating a natural, balanced stone appearance. Kyle Reichrath Project Coordinator Where does Kenai work best? Kenai is ideal for: - Modern exteriors - Outdoor living spaces - Accent walls - Neutral design styles Joshua Burck Project Coordinator Do GenStone panels require maintenance? GenStone requires very little maintenance. Most installations only need occasional cleaning with mild soap and water to remove dust or debris. Jagger Gottschalk Project Coordinator Do I need special tools to install GenStone panels? No special masonry tools are required. Most projects can be completed using common tools like a circular saw, screws, a drill, and a level. The panels are easy to cut and install using standard woodworking tools. Kevin O'Dwyer General Manager How do you install faux stone panels on a fireplace? Many fireplace installs use screws and/or construction adhesive depending on the surface and the project. Plan the layout, keep everything level, stagger seams, cut panels to fit, then finish edges with trim or caulk per the product guide and local code requirements.
